summary: Sprott Inc. filed a Form 6-K (the US-equivalent foreign-private-issuer current report) to announce only the timing of its 2026 third-quarter earnings release. Results are scheduled for 7:00 a.m. on November 4, 2026, with a same-morning webcast at 10:00 a.m. ET hosted by CEO Whitney George, CFO/Co-COO Kevin Hibbert and Sprott Asset Management CEO John Ciampaglia. No transaction, stake, price or recommendation is disclosed. It is a routine earnings-calendar notice with no risk-arb or special-situations angle to watch.
